additionalInfo: Decibel Eleven Time After Time Operation Manual. Hold B footswitch at power-on to set MIDI channel 1-16 (10-16 shown as 0-6 with center yellow LED). Soft takeover: CCs ignored until value matches knob. Expression can map to knobs, Tap Mode, Mod Speed.
